label: Early copy steps (outputs 1-2) when y/x/e is being or about to be output, in short sequences
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.9% of mass), at the first copy steps after the delimiter: recall_idx 1 (step L+1) holds 68% of mass, recall_idx 2 holds 27%, and recall_idx 3 holds 4%. It is essentially silent in the original phase, at the delimiter step, and from recall_idx 4 on. Rate falls as L grows (L 4-6 is high, L 8-9 is low). Which token is being output now or next sets the rate and magnitude: y gives about 10x lift, then x, e, 1, q, v, c. All top activations (around 0.9-1.0 of max) are at step L+1 with y or x as the output or next output. The position condition alone, (phase==2)&(recall_idx<=2), has recall 0.91 and mass recall 0.95 but precision only 0.14. Adding the token condition raises precision to about 0.5 but loses about 40% of mass. The token dependence is graded, not a crisp set, so precision and recall stay incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the next token to output (most: y, x, e, v, q, c; least: z, 2, o, p) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: y, x, e, 1; delimiter step: y; input phase: ); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=1, recall_idx=2, t=7.
